script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The comparison about a mother being up at every hour and never clocking out is a modern parenting scenario, which the audience rules exclude.

“Won’t leave anyone embarrassed” can suggest that those who hope in the LORD will never experience embarrassment. The verse promises they will never be put to shame.
It attributes the question in verse 24 to the LORD, but the passage does not identify who asks it.
